summary: Sector-wide: UNH, Cigna, Humana all beat Q1 2026 estimates, signaling managed-care recovery. All three (plus Aetna) scaled back Medicare Advantage footprint for 2026 to trim underperforming counties. Humana projects >25% MA membership growth in 2026, potentially overtaking UNH as largest MA carrier (~7.3M vs UNH ~5.8M at end 2025). Antitrust suit (Zelis vs Aetna/Cigna/Elevance/Humana/UNH) denied dismissal March 30, 2026 — sector legal risk.
